behaviors.statement: Final score is one deterministic integer 0-100 whose displayed arithmetic reconciles via round-half-up and a single clamp
Base B is the sum of three independently capped categories: project <=45, capacity <=25, fit <=48 (the sum of every fit signal)
Only the freshest valid arm's-length transfer earns mover influence; nominal price, sales code, and invalid or future dates disqualify
Mover strength is 90 through day 90, follows the normalized exponential through day 364, and is 0 from day 365
The mover blend lifts B toward the 90-100 priority band while preserving base differentiation
A current verified rental registration applies -25 after the blend; a registration older than the latest valid sale is stale-neutral; missing registry data is neutral with a data gap
An active qualifying permit adds 15 only with a qualifying lifecycle event in the last 12 months; an old Open label alone is not active
A qualifying permit completed within 24 months adds 15, requiring a terminal disposition and a reliable completion date
Every distinct qualifying permit earns 15 independently — three saturate the 45 project cap; there are no multi-permit or major-scope bonuses
Voided, stale, denied, expired, and administrative-only records earn no project points and contractor-churn scoring does not exist
The same municipal record seen in multiple sources is coalesced and counts once
Local relative value scores 0/3/7/10 by ratio to the median of the 20 closest valid comparables, neutral with a gap below 10 comparables
Territory assessed-value percentile scores 0/3/7/10 using deterministic midrank percentiles
An ACS dual-income prior at or above 35% adds 5 and is always described as a neighborhood-level prior
A missing capacity signal is neutral for that signal only and never blocks other capacity signals
Roof age scores 0/4/8/12 only from an explicitly completed full-replacement record; generic or non-install roof records leave age unknown and neutral
Home age scores 0/5/8/10 by construction-year bands
Verified 2015-to-2020 condition decline adds 8 unless a later completed exterior project supersedes it
A pool adds 8 and solar adds 5, each once, from a completed explicit permit or qualifying imagery; an active installation permit does not establish the feature
A lot of at least 0.5 acres adds 5
A door with unavailable SDL and imagery data still scores from remaining sources and carries explicit data gaps
Every temporal window and age derives from the declared as_of date, never wall-clock time
Owner names, mailing addresses, and agent identity present in source records never influence matching, scoring, or the emitted envelope
A lower-precedence source may fill a missing parcel fact only on an exact current match and must never overwrite a present higher-precedence value
